title: Practice 8: Running, swimming, climbing, crawling, dragging

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: В аквариуме ___ (плавать — to swim, float, sail, there and back or in general) одинокая рыба-клоун.
exercises.why: **плавала** — past tense (feminine) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).
exercises.prompt: A lone clownfish was swimming in the aquarium.

exercises.q: Его огромная гравитация ___ (тащить — to drag, one way) много астероидов из внешнего пояса вовнутрь.
exercises.why: **тащит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of тащить: one-direction verb (many directions: таскать).
exercises.prompt: Its massive gravity well tugs many asteroids from the outer belt inwards.

exercises.q: Будучи ребёнком, Ахмад умел ___ (лазить — to climb, there and back or in general) по высоким деревьям.
exercises.why: **лазить** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: лезть).
exercises.prompt: When Ahmad was a boy, he could climb tall trees.

exercises.q: Ты не ___ (плавать — to swim, float, sail, there and back or in general) в молодости в водах эпичности?
exercises.why: **плавал** — past tense (masculine) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).
exercises.prompt: Did you swim in the waters of awesomeness when younger?

exercises.q: Они сделали прорубь и ___ (плавать — to swim, float, sail, there and back or in general) в ледяной воде.
exercises.why: **плавали** — past tense (plural) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).
exercises.prompt: They cut a hole in the ice and swam in the freezing water.

exercises.q: Игривый слоненок ___ (гонять — to drive, chase, there and back or in general) белых цапель по буйным травам саванны.
exercises.why: **гонял** — past tense (masculine) of гонять: many-directions verb (one direction: гнать).
exercises.prompt: The playful elephant calf chased egrets through the lush grass of the savannah.

exercises.q: Ледниковый период был временем, когда по Земле ___ (бродить — to wander, plod, there and back or in general) волосатые мамонты.
exercises.why: **бродили** — past tense (plural) of бродить: many-directions verb (one direction: брести).
exercises.prompt: The Ice Age was a time when woolly mammoths roamed the Earth.

exercises.q: Каштанка ___ (бегать — to run, there and back or in general) взад и вперёд и не находила хозяина, а между тем становилось темно.
exercises.why: **бегала** — past tense (feminine) of бегать: many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).
exercises.prompt: Kashtanka ran back and forth but couldn't find her master. Meanwhile, it was getting dark.

exercises.q: Строителям, как и моему двоюродному брату, часто приходится ___ (таскать — to drag, there and back or in general) тяжести на стройплощадку.
exercises.why: **таскать** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: тащить).
exercises.prompt: Builders, like my cousin, often have to carry heavy materials to site.

exercises.q: В расследовании пока нет особых подвижек. Убийцу всё ещё ищут, полиция по-прежнему ___ (бродить — to wander, plod, there and back or in general) наощупь.
exercises.why: **бродит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of бродить: many-directions verb (one direction: брести).
exercises.prompt: There hasn't been much progress in the investigation. The murderer is still at large, and the police still in the dark.

exercises.q: ___ (бежать — to run, one way) к ней?
exercises.why: **бежать** — infinitive, one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: А ты ___ (лезть — to climb, one way).
exercises.why: **лезешь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: Но он ___ (бежать — to run, one way)!
exercises.why: **бежал** — past tense (masculine) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: А ты ___ (лезть — to climb, one way)!
exercises.why: **лезешь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: Что ж, ___ (бежать — to run, one way)?
exercises.why: **бежать** — infinitive, one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: ___ (бежать — to run, one way) от нас.
exercises.why: **бегут** — future tense (3rd person plural) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: ___ (бежать — to run, one way) к попу!
exercises.why: **беги** — imperative (ты, singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: Так и ___ (ползти — to crawl, one way).
exercises.why: **ползут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ползти: one-direction verb (many directions: ползать).

exercises.q: И куда ___ (лезть — to climb, one way)?
exercises.why: **лезем** — present tense (1st person plural) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: ___ (бежать — to run, one way) в кухню!
exercises.why: **беги** — imperative (ты, singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).
